# Owned instance formal and context fixture

A public instance method retains an Object-bounded method formal in a direct
fallback input and result beside independent Type/Object contexts. Its original
Exceptions attribute names an unchecked failure. A generic static wrapper
retains its Exception handler and default-false/soft fallback overloads.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every unit and preserve original
entries, fields, flags, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen direct, separately
compiled, reflection and MethodHandle callers run 144 fresh JVM cases twice.
They check virtual overrides, exact receiver/context/fallback/result identities,
nulls, aliases, mutations, opaque results, partial effects, original handlers
and exact late casts/failures. Reflection inputs trap inspection. Six wrong
programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the relation.
Only owned fixture code executes. Use JDK 25 for verification; originals compile
at release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
